description: The OSLO_TropStrat model component is embedded in the CAM-Nor model component of the NorESM model. It is based on the TS1 troposphere-stratosphere chemistry scheme of the MOZART (Model for Ozone and Related chemical Tracers) model component in CESM, but has specific adaptations to provide interfaces to the OSLO_AERO aerosol model component. The scheme describes the chemical evolution of 205 species through gas-phase reactions (356), aqueous phase reactions (2), heterogeneous reactions (12 in the troposphere and 17 in the stratosphere) and photolysis (113).
